jobDescription:
We are looking for a Senior Frontend Engineer with at least 5 years of professional experience building high-performance web applications. You will lead the development of our core customer dashboard, optimize web performance, and mentor junior engineers.

Key Requirements:
- 5+ years of hands-on experience with modern JavaScript, TypeScript, and React.
- Proven track record with SSR frameworks, specifically Next.js.
- Strong expertise in state management (Redux Toolkit, Zustand) and API integration (REST, GraphQL).
- Experience writing unit and integration tests using Jest and React Testing Library.
- Deep understanding of web performance optimization, core web vitals, and cross-browser compatibility.

Bonus Points:
- Experience with micro-frontend architectures.
- Familiarity with CI/CD deployment workflows on Vercel or AWS.

Acme Tech is seeking a Backend Developer with 3+ years of experience to design, build, and maintain robust server-side applications and database architectures.

Key Requirements:
- 3+ years of commercial backend development using Python and Django or FastAPI.
- Strong SQL proficiency and hands-on experience optimizing complex PostgreSQL queries.
- Experience designing and documenting RESTful APIs and WebSocket services.
- Knowledge of caching strategies using Redis and message queues like Celery or RabbitMQ.
- Hands-on experience with Docker containerization and basic Linux server administration.

Responsibilities:
- Develop secure, scalable backend services for our data pipeline.
- Collaborating with frontend teams to define API contracts.

We are searching for a versatile Full Stack Engineer with 4+ years of end-to-end web application development experience using the JavaScript/TypeScript ecosystem.

Qualifications Needed:
- 4+ years building full-stack applications with React on the frontend and Node.js/Express on the backend.
- Strong understanding of NoSQL database design (MongoDB/Mongoose) and relational databases.
- Familiarity with authentication strategies (JWT, OAuth2, Session management).
- Experience deploying applications using AWS services (S3, EC2, CloudFront).

What You Will Do:
- Own end-to-end features from database schema design down to UI components.
- Work closely with product managers to scope and deliver new product features on time.

We need a DevOps Engineer with 4+ years of cloud infrastructure management experience to automate, scale, and secure our multi-region AWS cloud setup.

Candidate Profile:
- 4+ years of dedicated DevOps or Site Reliability Engineering experience.
- Production experience managing Kubernetes clusters (EKS/GKE) and Helm charts.
- Proficient in Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform.
- Expertise in setting up automated CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions or GitLab CI.
- Strong scripting skills in Python or Bash for system automation.

Core Responsibilities:
- Maintain 99.99% infrastructure uptime and improve automated monitoring/alerting via Datadog and Prometheus.

Seeking a Product UI/UX Designer with 3+ years of experience designing complex B2B web and mobile SaaS applications.

Requirements:
- 3+ years of experience as a UI/UX Designer with a strong portfolio showcasing end-to-end design processes.
- Advanced expertise in Figma (auto-layout, components, interactive prototyping).
- Experience creating, maintaining, and scaling design systems across teams.
- Practical background conducting user interviews, usability testing, and wireframing.
- Ability to translate user feedback and product analytics into intuitive design solutions.

Looking for a Data Engineer with 4+ years of experience constructing scalable data platforms, pipeline orchestration, and enterprise data warehouses.

Job Qualifications:
- 4+ years of experience in data engineering, processing large-scale batch and streaming datasets.
- Advanced SQL skills and solid proficiency in Python.
- Extensive experience building pipeline orchestration using Apache Airflow.
- Production experience with modern data stack tools such as Snowflake, dbt, and BigQuery.
- Knowledge of data modeling techniques (Star Schema, Data Vault).

We are hiring a Technical Product Manager with 5+ years of software product management experience to drive product strategy and feature execution.

What We Expect:
- 5+ years managing technical products in an Agile/Scrum software development environment.
- Demonstrated ability to convert business goals into detailed user stories, PRDs, and technical specs.
- Strong analytical mindset with experience using tools like Mixpanel, Google Analytics, or Amplitude.
- Exceptional communication skills with a track record of balancing engineering priorities and stakeholder requirements.

Acme Tech is looking for a QA Automation Engineer with 3+ years of automated testing experience to build reliable end-to-end test suites.

Requirements:
- 3+ years of experience writing automated test frameworks using Playwright, Cypress, or Selenium.
- Strong proficiency in JavaScript or TypeScript for writing clean, maintainable test scripts.
- Hands-on experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Jenkins).
- Familiarity with API testing tools like Postman or Supertest.
- Experience in load testing (k6, JMeter) is a plus.

Seeking a Senior Mobile App Developer with 4+ years of cross-platform mobile development experience using React Native.

Key Requirements:
- 4+ years of commercial mobile app development experience with React Native and TypeScript.
- Experience publishing and maintaining applications on the Apple App Store and Google Play Store.
- Deep understanding of native iOS (Swift) and Android (Kotlin) code bridge modules.
- Experience optimizing mobile application performance, startup times, and memory consumption.
- Solid understanding of offline-first storage and push notification implementations.

We are seeking a Security Engineer with 5+ years of experience in application security and cloud infrastructure security.

Qualifications Needed:
- 5+ years in an Information Security or Application Security role.
- Practical experience conducting vulnerability assessments, threat modeling, and penetration testing.
- Strong knowledge of OWASP Top 10 vulnerabilities and secure code review processes.
- Experience securing AWS cloud workloads (IAM policies, KMS, Security Groups, GuardDuty).
- Familiarity with compliance frameworks including SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, and GDPR.
- Relevant certifications (CISSP, CEH, OSCP) preferred.
